name: label
description: The label of the range input.

name: min
description: The minimum value of the range input.

name: max
description: The maximum value of the range input.

name: id
description: The element ID of the range input.

name: modelValue
description: The value of the range input.

name: step
description: The step interval of the range input.

name: disabled
description: Determines if the range input is disabled.

name: inlineLabel
description: Determines if the label will be displayed next to the range input.

name: hideLabel
description: Determines if the label should be visually hidden. Note that it will still be accessible to screen readers.

name: inputClass
description: The classes to be applied on the range input itself, e.g. to constrain its width.
type: string | string[] | Record<string, boolean> | Record<string, boolean>[]
